name: Melevodopa
summary: Melevodopa, also known as levodopa methyl ester (LDME) and sold under the brand name Levomet, is a dopaminergic agent. It is the methyl ester of levodopa. It is used in oral tablet form as an effervescent prodrug with 250 times the water solubility of tablet levodopa. In combination with carbidopa, as melevodopa/carbidopa (brand name Sirio), it is approved for use in the treatment of Parkinson's disease.

sideEffects.en: Its effects are those of levodopa: nausea, dizziness on standing, sleepiness and, with long use, involuntary movements. It can also cause hallucinations, confusion and impulse control problems such as compulsive gambling.
sideEffects.zh: 它的作用與左旋多巴相同：噁心、起身時頭暈、嗜睡，長期使用會出現不自主動作。它也可能引起幻覺、混亂，以及強迫性賭博等衝動控制問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它的作用与左旋多巴相同：恶心、起身时头晕、嗜睡，长期使用会出现不自主动作。它也可能引起幻觉、混乱，以及强迫性赌博等冲动控制问题。

fact.en: Melevodopa is levodopa with a methyl ester attached, a small change that makes it far more soluble in water so that it can be given as a fizzy tablet.
fact.zh: Melevodopa 是在左旋多巴上接一個甲酯，這個小改變讓它的水溶性大幅提高，因此可以做成發泡錠。
fact.zhHans: Melevodopa 是在左旋多巴上接一个甲酯，这个小改变让它的水溶性大幅提高，因此可以做成发泡锭。
